- Initial release of remind-fpx skill.
- Enables shell access to Remind (remind.com) classes, chats, messages, and notification settings using GraphQL API via captured browser session.
- Uses @fetchproxy/cli and Chrome Transporter extension for one-time header capture; works without running the remind-mcp server.
- Provides setup instructions and sample query patterns for fetching data securely via curl.
- Read-focused: guides for safe introspection, robust session handling, and field validation included.
